dependency_fingerprints.scope: post-run installed package source and native extension files; versions matched measurement and selected file mtimes predate its start; not an in-process loader attestation
dependency_fingerprints.algorithm: SHA256 over sorted package-relative filename, NUL, file SHA256 hex, newline

functional_equivalence.scope: complete parsed MCP initialize, list and call results

rss_scope: sum of Python stdio shim and all its child processes; driver and HTTP fixture excluded
scope: local disposable HTTP fixture; startup remains Python/SDK; no daemon or live bank
baseline: current candidate Python transport with Rust selection disabled

measurement.startup: fresh shim process through completed MCP initialize; filesystem caches not cleared
measurement.ordinary: 40 sequential read calls per trial, following initialize and tools/list; no read warmup
measurement.bulk: one complete 1400000-byte SSE text result per trial
measurement.concurrent: one asyncio.gather burst of eight read tool calls on one MCP stdio session per trial
measurement.control: complete parsed result hashes equal for initialize, tools/list and every tools/call

rss_ownership.included: every newly created recursive descendant of the benchmark driver, including Python shim launcher, Python interpreter, Rust helper and console host descendants
rss_ownership.excluded: sampling parent/benchmark driver, its in-process HTTP fixture and its threads, private launcher and any descendant existing before trial
rss_ownership.process_discovery: PID plus creation time; children(recursive=True) on every sample; no command lines recorded
rss_ownership.composition_diagnostic: one separate untimed disposable run; no diagnostic timing promoted
rss_ownership.total_rss: sum of working-set RSS; shared resident pages may be counted in more than one process

limitations: Four paired trials on one Windows host are descriptive; no significance or broad platform claim.
Process-cold startup includes Python and SDK imports, upstream handshake and fixture cost; operating-system filesystem caches remain warm.
No explicit read warmup; ordinary requests follow initialize and list. The small mean difference may be noise.
The HTTP fixture is the existing connection-closing HTTP/1.0 ThreadingHTTPServer with its default accept backlog; fixture scheduling and per-call upstream handshakes contribute to burst time.
One bulk call and one eight-call burst per trial; these are fixture-specific, not daemon or production-bank throughput.
Active request throughput divides the 49 tool calls by summed measured request durations; inter-call assertions, hashing, tools/list, startup and teardown are excluded.
RSS is sampled every 10ms as a simultaneous process sum; shorter peaks and exited-before-sample processes can be missed.
Complete parsed MCP result equivalence covers this workload; it does not prove wire-envelope identity or every recovery/security path.
Original-base Python regression sanity was not measured; this baseline is the current candidate default Python transport.
No daemon rewrite, GPU/model workload or live bank was measured.
assessment: Not a maximum-speed/minimum-total-memory candidate for this defined workload: startup improves, ordinary mean changes little, bulk and concurrent calls regress and total sampled peak RSS increases.
